source_qualification.decision: Fixed full matrix expansion, no target feedback, sourceV ranking, parameter scan, or selective repeat. Upload this decision before reading own new target summaries.

source_falsification.selection: All five first-seed source trajectories must pass fixed health/implementation checks. Freeze and push source-only expansion decision before reading any new target summary; only then release unchanged seeds02/03. No sourceV ranking or target feedback.

result.interpretation: B-A tests X3 on RDrop. E-C and E-D test unified vs separate policies; E-D also changes units, clipping metric and decay. F-E and F-B test combination increments. Positive F-E-B+A suggests complementary effects; three seeds do not establish statistical significance.
result.limitation: Fixed paired matrix with all negative results; exposed ManySig clean, not new blind/newTX/Phase2. No implied addition of historical gains.
